initializationAction: q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run playsound minecraft:entity.firework_rocket.twinkle ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1');

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Wow! You have a perfect match of all five numbers!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: We have a grand prize winner! You have won a Master Ball!

action: q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run give @s cobblemon:master_ball');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run playsound minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup ambient @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1');

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Tune in again tomorrow and see me for another chance at a prize!
